name: Armor Durability
description: Every piece of armour lasts {{multiplier}} times as long before it breaks.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Durability multiplier
settings.help: Whole numbers only - these are whole-number columns in the game. 1 leaves it at stock. Capped at x10: the highest-durability piece in the stock game already sits at the field's own historical ceiling, so x10 is as far as this can go while staying within a defensible multiple of ground the game is known to handle.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_part SET dur = dur * {{multiplier}} WHERE type IN ('PTTP_HEAD', 'PTTP_BODY', 'PTTP_LEGS');
